title: The Room Nobody Visits
subtitle: 传统现代 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 传统现代（历史社会与文化·传统与现代）
meta: 主题语境：传统现代（历史社会与文化·传统与现代）　|　核心词汇：section　|　正文 283 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 section 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The county museum has eleven ① sections, and the one nobody visits is the last: a ② section of the building at the top of the house, eleven steps up and one window, where somebody has put everything the county could not decide about.

There is a ③ section of the local paper from 1974 pinned to the wall, yellow, in which the museum's opening is reported in eleven lines at the bottom of the page, in the same section as the births and deaths. My grandmother is in the photograph, third from the left, and she is the only person in it looking at the floor.

For thirty-one years she worked in the ④ section of the county offices that dealt with burials, which everybody else avoided, which nobody thanked her for, and which she said was the only ⑤ section of any office worth working in, because nobody there lies.

On the first Saturday of every month the ⑥ string section of the school orchestra played in the entrance hall, badly, and my grandmother, who had never liked music, stood at the back every time. The ⑦ cross section of the hall, as the architect drew it in 1974, shows why: the sound goes up and comes back, and the section of wall behind the players is bare brick.

The museum calls that room 'Social History', a name my grandmother said was invented by a ⑧ section of society that has never had any. The ⑨ section of the staircase above it — eleven steps and one turn — is the part I remember best. I have not been up there since 2011, and the ⑩ section of the building is now closed for repairs, which I suspect means for good.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 部分；区域；展区
B. n. （报纸、书刊的）版面；栏目
D. n. 地区；区域（a section of the country）
E. n. 剖面；截面（a cross section）
F. n. 段；一段（a section of the route / staircase）
G. n. （乐队的）组；声部（the string section）
H. n. 阶层；群体（a section of society）

items.q: The county museum has eleven sections
a section of the building at the top of the house
There is a section of the local paper
she worked in the section of the county offices
the only section of any office worth working in
the string section of the school orchestra
The cross section of the hall
a section of society that has never had any
The section of the staircase above it
The section of the building is now closed

answers.why: sections 意为“展区、部分”，县博物馆有十一个展区。
a section of ... 意为“……的一个区域／地区”，此处指房子顶层那一块地方。
a section of the paper 意为“报纸的一个版面”，1974 年那份报纸钉在墙上。
the section of ... 意为“……的处／科”，她在县机关里管殡葬的那个科。
section 意为“部门、科”，她说那是任何机关里唯一值得待的部门。
the string section 意为“弦乐组”，学校管弦乐队的弦乐组每月来演奏一次。
cross section 意为“剖面图”，建筑师 1974 年画的大厅剖面图说明了原因。
a section of society 意为“社会上的一个阶层／群体”，她说这名字是从没有历史的人发明的。
a section of ... 意为“一段”，楼梯上面那一段：十一级台阶加一个转弯。
the section of the building 意为“建筑的这一部分”，现在因维修关闭。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 县博物馆有十一个展区。（sections）
楼顶那部分是全楼唯一没人去的地方。（a section of）
墙上钉着 1974 年当地报纸的一个版面。（a section of the paper）
她在县机关里管殡葬的那个科干了三十一年。（section）
每月第一个星期六，学校管弦乐队的弦乐组在大厅演奏。（the string section）
建筑师 1974 年画的大厅剖面图说明了原因。（cross section）
answers: The county museum has eleven sections.
A section of the building at the top of the house is the only one nobody visits.
There is a section of the local paper from 1974 pinned to the wall.
She worked in the section of the county offices that dealt with burials for thirty-one years.
The string section of the school orchestra played in the entrance hall every month.
The cross section of the hall, as the architect drew it in 1974, shows why.
